behavior.caller_failure_full_consumption: parser succeeds but trailing characters remain (remaining length at [rsp+0x8] != 0): return 0, destination unchanged
behavior.caller_failure_out_of_range: parsed value >= level count at [outer+0x778] (unsigned compare): return 0, destination unchanged
behavior.caller_failure_overflow: parser reports overflow: return 0, destination unchanged
behavior.caller_failure_parse: parser returns 0 (empty view or a non-digit first character): return 0, destination unchanged
behavior.caller_success: parser succeeds, the whole view is consumed, and the parsed value is below the level count: the level's ratio is formatted with "%f" into a temporary string, move-assigned into the destination string, and 1 is returned
behavior.caller_success_ratio_sentinel: the ratio callee's -1.0 sentinel is NOT checked by the caller: an empty level or a zero denominator still formats as "-1.000000" and returns 1
behavior.formatter: the formatted value is the ratio double in xmm0, formatted with "%f" (bytes at 0x1df3ed) by 0x514c050 into the temporary string at rsp+0x20; the formatter's other arguments (rsi from GOT 0x5778378, edx 0x148, rcx format address, al 1) are passed through as recorded by its own bind
behavior.general: given an outer object, a destination string, and a (pointer, length) view holding a decimal level index, format that level's ratio as "%f" into the destination and return 1, or return 0 without touching the destination when the view is not exactly one in-range decimal index
behavior.move_assign: the temporary string is moved into the destination by 0x514b4f0 (its SSO/heap arms are bound by its own item); the temporary's heap buffer, when present, is then sized-deleted with size capacity + 1 via _ZdlPvm@plt, and the SSO case deletes nothing
behavior.parser_empty: an empty view (length 0) returns 0 and writes 0 to the output slot
behavior.parser_non_digit: a non-digit character stops the scan: the function returns 1 with the accumulated value when at least one digit was consumed, else 0 with value 0; the view struct is left pointing at the stopping character with the remaining length
behavior.parser_overflow: accumulation is checked against UINT64_MAX: value > 0x1999999999999999, or value == 0x1999999999999999 with the next digit > 5, returns 0 without writing the output slot; the view struct keeps the consumption of the digits before the overflowing digit
behavior.parser_rule: scan decimal digits from the view pointer, accumulating value = value * 10 + digit in uint64; stop at the first non-digit or at the end of the view
behavior.ratio_denominator_zero: after the loop, a zero denominator sum returns the constant double -1.0 (bytes at 0x20a278)
behavior.ratio_empty_span: an entry whose begin pointer equals its end pointer returns the constant double -1.0 without reading any record
behavior.ratio_rule: for the level entry at index (signed 32-bit truncation of the parsed value): numerator = sum over records of ([record+0x90] + [record+0x98]), denominator = sum over records of [record+0x10]; the result is (double)(uint64)numerator / (double)(uint64)denominator, where the uint64 conversions use the binary's unsigned-conversion sequences for negative int64 sums
behavior.ratio_sums_wrap: both sums are int64 additions and wrap modulo 2^64; the zero-denominator check is on the wrapped value

calls.kind: sized delete of the temporary heap buffer

container_layout.header: outer + 0x788 points to a sub-object; [sub-object + 0x30] is the level container
container_layout.level_array: [level container + 0xad8] (equivalently [(level container + 0x40) + 0xa98] as the ratio callee reads it)
container_layout.level_count: outer + 0x778, signed 64-bit, compared unsigned against the parsed value

note_on_window_callers: A full .text direct-e8 scan, a full .text e9 tail-jump scan, and a whole-file qword-pointer scan found no reference to 0x514cc10. The behavior is complete end to end through its callees (parser, ratio, formatter, move-assign, temp cleanup); only its reaching path is unclaimed, as with the RE-001 level-report item, which likewise has no direct caller.
unknowns: The source-level name of the ratio (which two summed quantities it divides) beyond the three record fields
Whether the ratio's -1.0 sentinel is ever distinguished by any other consumer; this caller does not distinguish it
The index truncation edge: the caller gates on the full 64-bit parsed value but the ratio callee truncates it to signed 32 bits; level counts above INT32_MAX are outside the modelled range
